properties.rationale: RULED 2026-09-15 (Anthony): UNCHANGED, DELIBERATELY. heal.rs merge_survivor still ranks by provenance and breaks a tie by id — read again today — and the finding's own record says why that stands: ranking priority above status (or the reverse) asserts a policy about what matters more, which dec:readiness-is-an-observation-the-threshold-is-the-judgement says reflow2 must not default. What was done instead is disclosure: a merge proposal names what it would destroy and says when the alphabet chose the victim, and any deletion requires human review. The four listed repairs (two checksum acceptances, the instruction-surface routing, the wall check) do not touch survivor selection. The scoring half — weight similarity by shared referents rather than prose — is still open and is a separate piece of work. Acknowledged as a deliberate state.
